name: VRM_REVENUE_DOCUMENTS_ALL
description: VRM_REVENUE_DOCUMENTS_ALL contains source document header information that is used to create the revenue document. There will be one revenue document per event raised by the source system.

columns.description: Unique identifier of a revenue document.
